description.value: The Blue Hat Bakery & Cafe is the public-facing student training café operated by the Pacific Institute of Culinary Arts (PICAchef), Vancouver's premier culinary school since 1997. Baked goods and café fare are produced by students enrolled in the school's Baking & Pastry Arts programs under professional chef supervision. It shares the building with the Blue Hat Bistro event space at the school's West 2nd Avenue campus.
